admission.justification: The snapshot adapter constructs forward and reverse references while docHead.tsx renders their known metadata, preventing a task head from presenting only half of the declared dependency relation.

applicability: Dependency facts in the head of a task of an ordinary master.
conditions: Waits-for references come from the field; needed-by references are derived from the listed sibling population.
Known dependency ids and titles stay visible; gone targets remain marked gone and nonnavigable.

A dependency without a task document has no state and no jump; no second path for task state is added. This is the intentional narrower guarantee in Architect ruling notes/run3/L168-THE-INSTRUCTIONS-OF-THE-REMOVED-ADOPTION-ARE-CORRECTED-A-FILE-LESS-DEPENDENCY-SHOWS-NO-STATE.json (ruling[2]).

evidence: Parent examination of actual F01 changed extents; no new execution or acceptance.

statement: A task head presents its waits-for and derived needed-by tasks with their known id and title; state and navigation require the referenced native task entry. A dependency without a task document shows id and title, no state and no jump.
